# Gradient mesh

Broad fields of color create atmosphere without adding clutter.

## Use

Use for learning hubs, editorial introductions, and product overview pages.

## Essential traits

- Diffuse color transitions
- Simple content structure
- Stable text backgrounds

## Typography

System sans-serif with spacious bold headings.

## Layout and surfaces

Large diffuse color fields and clean aligned content panels. Soft overlapping violet, blue, and rose gradients behind solid text surfaces.

## Palette

- background: #202050
- surface: #282a5a
- text: #f8f6ff
- muted: #d4d0ee
- accent: #efe0ff
- border: #777ab0
